title: **Pezeshkian Arrives in New Delhi**
text:
**Pezeshkian Arrives in New Delhi**"

"🔹Iran’s president arrived in New Delhi on Friday noon local time, where he was welcomed by Shantanu Thakur, India’s Minister of State for Ports, Shipping and Waterways, and Iran’s ambassador."

"Video by Zahra Asghari, ISNA correspondent on assignment.
